title: LuckyDraws
description: A configurable daily lucky draw system for multiplayer servers, granting unique rewards per player with optional bonus effects.
body:
# LuckyDraws

LuckyDraws is a Forge server-side mod for Minecraft 1.20.1.
It runs a daily lucky draw for every online player at a configurable in-game time.

## Highlights

- Daily draw with per-player random item and count
- Draw count uses a normal distribution
- Special items may include random enchantments and NBT attributes
- One reroll per player per day
- Optional random potion bonus
- Optional random nearby mob spawn
- Item blacklist support
- Config hot reload via command

## Server-side Focus

Only the server needs this mod installed. Clients can join without installing LuckyDraws.

## Commands

Player:

- `/luckydraws reroll`
- `/luckydraws history`
- `/luckydraws help`

Admin:

- `/luckydraws show`
- `/luckydraws config reload`
- `/luckydraws mobspawn on|off|status`

## Config

Main config file:

- `.minecraft/config/luckydraws-common.toml`

Example blacklist:

```toml
drawItemBlacklist = ["minecraft:bedrock", "minecraft:command_block"]
```

## Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge 47.x
- Java 17
